offering_description.value: Kinetik gathers and processes natural gas for oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin. It operates pipelines and facilities that move gas to downstream markets, gather and stabilize crude oil, and collect and dispose of produced water. It also sells natural gas and natural gas liquids under certain producer contracts.

primary_products.value: natural gas liquids; pipeline-quality natural gas

primary_services.value: natural gas gathering and compression; natural gas treating and processing; pipeline transportation; crude oil gathering and stabilization; produced water gathering and disposal

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, pipeline shippers, and wholesale natural gas and natural gas liquids buyers

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; natural gas transmission and wholesale markets; crude oil transportation; natural gas liquids markets

revenue_model.value: service fees: Volume-based charges for gathering, processing, transportation, crude stabilization, and water disposal; product sales: Sales of natural gas and recovered natural gas liquids under producer purchase or processing arrangements

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Runs gathering lines, processing plants, transportation pipelines, and disposal facilities that handle producer volumes; service provider: Processes raw gas, stabilizes crude oil, and handles produced water for oil and gas producers

geography_served.value: US regional: Delaware Basin in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Natural gas gathering, processing, and transportation, plus crude oil and produced water handling

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Contracts with producers and shippers, with commodity deliveries through pipeline interconnections

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal and state pipeline safety and environmental rules, plus state permits for produced water injection wells
